description.en: The ID of the Cloud Enterprise Network (CEN) instance.

description.zh: 分页查询时每页显示的条目数。默认值：**20**。
description.en: The number of entries to return on each page. Default value: **20**.

description.zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：
- 第一次查询和没有下一次查询时，均无需填写。
- 如果有下一次查询，取值为上一次API调用返回的NextToken值。
description.en:
The token that determines the start point of the next query. Valid values:

*   If this is your first query and no subsequent queries are to be sent, ignore this parameter.
*   If a subsequent query is to be sent, set the parameter to the value of NextToken that is returned from the last call.

description.zh:
转发路由器实例所属的地域ID。

您可以通过调用[DescribeChildInstanceRegions](~~132080~~)接口获取地域ID。
description.en:
The region ID of the transit router.

You can call the [DescribeChildInstanceRegions](~~132080~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

description.zh:
云企业网实例的标签信息。

一次最多支持查询20个标签。
description.en:
The information about the tags that are added to the CEN instance.

You can query at most 20 tags in each call.
The ID of the VPN attachment.
The ID of the transit router.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cbn list-transit-router-vpn-attachments --cen-id cen-rsgxs8ng2awen20000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --transit-router-attachment-id tr-attach-a6p8voaodog5c00000 --transit-router-id tr-p0wm740vjnbaprv0m0000 --max-results 20 --next-token FFmyTO70tTpLG6I3FmYAXGKPd0000 --tag Value=value_A1 Key=tagtest --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cbn ListTransitRouterVpnAttachments --region cn-hangzhou --TransitRouterAttachmentId 'tr-attach-a6p8voaodog5c00000' --Tag.1.Key tagtest --NextToken FFmyTO70tTpLG6I3FmYAXGKPd0000 --MaxResults 20 --Tag.1.Value value_A1 --CenId 'cen-rsgxs8ng2awen20000' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --TransitRouterId 'tr-p0wm740vjnbaprv0m0000'
